16 / 22 Energy
A feasibility study from public data: not a design, a quote or an approval.
Where the power goes
At full load, every watt the building draws
ends up as heat. How much of it the public
floors can use is not known yet: there is no
sourced figure for how much heat an
air-cooled hall gives up.
at the meter: servers 1.76 MW times PUE 1.55
heat on offer a year after the heat pump, if the
hall were liquid-cooled (a range, not a modelled
network)
158 to 267 MWh
heat the public floors need a year (871 m², from
national building-type averages; an estimate)
